## Exercise `r exercise_number`: Create an Posit Cloud Account 

You should have received an e-mail from posit.com with the Subject: Mark Jensen has invited you to access a space on Posit Cloud? It was sent to your university email account.
There is a link in the e-mail that will take you to create a Posit Cloud account. Once you created your account and log-on you will be taken RStudio. 

If you have already created a Posit Cloud account please log-on to it now.
If you have not created an account please find this e-mail and do so now.
